name: RevitMCPViewCommandSet
description: UI view command collection for Revit AI assistance

commands.description: Activate a Revit UI view without opening a transaction
Close an open Revit UI view without opening a transaction
Read active view, open views, selection, and document UI state
Find Revit elements by category and text across name, family, type, mark, and comments
Open an existing plan view for an element's level and focus the element without creating a new view
Select and zoom to Revit elements in the active or requested view without opening a transaction
Apply a 3D section box around Revit elements and optionally select and zoom to them
Create or reuse a 3D view for Revit elements, optionally apply/clear section box, activate it, and focus the elements
